name: L10-PanoLab one-step active-observation Development ceiling
question: Can one bounded PAN, SWEEP, APPROACH, SIDESTEP, or HOLD action materially improve unique target-entrance binding or loss reacquisition on real posed street-image sequences?

cohort.panel_design: stratified causal Development panel; individual causal truth is unchanged, but the same target way is not required to instantiate all four rare conditions

source_diversity.TENANT_WRONG_ENTRANCE: two strict target ways with three frozen start/tenant/view variants each

cohort.source_disjointness: distinct Panoramax image and sequence IDs within each scenario; non-tenant strata use six distinct target ways and exclude PB18, PB19, and the generic PanoLab roster
cohort.truth_freeze: marker-blind source audit freezes each target entrance, plausible decoy set, visibility, occlusion class, and raw viewport interval before policy replay

panel_change_receipt.reason: the crossed same-POI 6-by-4 source was not evaluable: France supplied two of six strict full-matrix ways, while bounded Belgium and Taiwan repairs supplied zero additional ways
panel_change_receipt.unchanged: 24 total episodes, six episodes per causal class, strict per-episode ownership and occlusion truth, one-step action set, oracle and decision thresholds
panel_change_receipt.development_limit: tenant-policy generalization is not source-disjoint beyond two target ways

action_contract.movement_view_rule: preserve the frozen raw panorama center across sequence items; do not synthesize a world-aligned heading
action_contract.movement_availability_rule: execute movement only on a frozen same-sequence reciprocal prev/next pair; otherwise return the unchanged observation with action_executed=false
action_contract.movement_role_rule: map a frozen pair to APPROACH only when target-building-centroid distance decreases; otherwise map its signed target-relative lateral displacement to exactly one SIDESTEP action without entrance truth
action_contract.PAN_LEFT: rotate the viewport center by -75 raw panorama degrees without using world bearing
action_contract.PAN_RIGHT: rotate the viewport center by +75 raw panorama degrees without using world bearing
action_contract.SWEEP: return four 90-degree viewports at frozen raw offsets 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees from the starting center
action_contract.APPROACH: move to one frozen adjacent posed image selected from target-centroid geometry without evaluator entrance truth
action_contract.SIDESTEP_LEFT: move to one frozen adjacent posed image on the left side of the sequence path
action_contract.SIDESTEP_RIGHT: move to one frozen adjacent posed image on the right side of the sequence path
action_contract.HOLD: retain the current image and viewport

orientation_boundary.reason: public Panoramax items do not generally expose enough heading provenance and full yaw-pitch-roll semantics for a universal raw-pixel world-bearing projection

oracle.scope: one-step evaluator-only ceiling; never exposed to the runtime policy
oracle.tie_break: correct unique, target visible, not wrong unique, lower ambiguity, then fixed action order

decision_rule.if_oracle_below_minimum: close active observation on this representation
decision_rule.if_fixed_within_gap: retain the best fixed action without training
decision_rule.otherwise: open a trainable action selector on a new split
